import ctypes
import math

def check_special_floats(value):
    # Load libraries in correct order
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    
    # Set up function prototypes
    gsl.gsl_isnan.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_isnan.restype = ctypes.c_int
    
    gsl.gsl_isinf.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_isinf.restype = ctypes.c_int
    
    gsl.gsl_finite.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_finite.restype = ctypes.c_int
    
    # Call the GSL functions
    isnan_result = gsl.gsl_isnan(ctypes.c_double(value))
    isinf_result = gsl.gsl_isinf(ctypes.c_double(value))
    isfinite_result = gsl.gsl_finite(ctypes.c_double(value))
    
    return (bool(isnan_result), isinf_result, bool(isfinite_result))

def assert_test():
    # Test with NaN
    result = check_special_floats(float('nan'))
    assert result[0] == True, "NaN should be detected as NaN"
    assert result[1] == 0, "NaN should not be detected as infinity"
    assert result[2] == False, "NaN should not be finite"
    
    # Test with positive infinity
    result = check_special_floats(float('inf'))
    assert result[0] == False, "Positive infinity should not be NaN"
    assert result[1] == 1, "Positive infinity should return 1"
    assert result[2] == False, "Positive infinity should not be finite"
    
    # Test with negative infinity
    result = check_special_floats(float('-inf'))
    assert result[0] == False, "Negative infinity should not be NaN"
    assert result[1] == -1, "Negative infinity should return -1"
    assert result[2] == False, "Negative infinity should not be finite"
    
    # Test with finite positive number
    result = check_special_floats(3.14159)
    assert result[0] == False, "Finite number should not be NaN"
    assert result[1] == 0, "Finite number should not be infinity"
    assert result[2] == True, "Finite number should be finite"
    
    # Test with finite negative number
    result = check_special_floats(-2.71828)
    assert result[0] == False, "Finite negative number should not be NaN"
    assert result[1] == 0, "Finite negative number should not be infinity"
    assert result[2] == True, "Finite negative number should be finite"
    
    # Test with zero
    result = check_special_floats(0.0)
    assert result[0] == False, "Zero should not be NaN"
    assert result[1] == 0, "Zero should not be infinity"
    assert result[2] == True, "Zero should be finite"
    
    print("All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
